implementation_outline: Write a requirements document, data-flow design and threat/privacy review.
Build reproducible import and validation steps for synthetic/authorized data.
Add analysis, uncertainty-aware models and labelled visuals.
Build report and Shiny views with responsive error states.
Add tests, dependency lock, operational documentation and an honest review of limitations.
key_features: Import from files, databases and authorized APIs
Validate inputs and repeatable data cleaning
Conduct exploratory, statistical and predictive analysis
Generate visualizations and reproducible Quarto reports
Include reusable functions or an accompanying package
Test critical functions and generated outputs
Manage dependencies and document deployment, provenance, assumptions and limits
answer.acceptance_summary: Deliver a source repository, setup instructions, validated sample data, report, interactive app, automated tests and final technical report.

explanation: Reference solution outline for “R Data Intelligence Platform — Capstone”. This is a review guide, not a claim that a complete, executable reference implementation has been built or run. A reviewer should verify functionality, statistical assumptions, tests, security and reproducibility before publishing.
